title: Appointment Series No-Show Fee — Amount Worksheet
content:
Patient Accounts worksheet for the amount of a no-show fee on an Appointment Series.

**Definition.** The no-show fee is the no-show basis, and the no-show basis is the no-show fee of the series' visit format. The amount is carried unrounded through the calculation and rounded to the nearest cent a single time, at the end.

**Inputs.**

| Input | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| Visit format of the series | the series record |
| No-show fee of that format | the format's figure |

**Worked line (hypothetical figure).** Format no-show fee USD 65.00, so the no-show basis is USD 65.00 and the no-show fee charged is USD 65.00.
